nodes.name: Slurry preparation by ball milling
nodes.procedure: The slurry was prepared by ball milling of Ni powder (14 wt %), Fe powder (5.7 wt %), Starch (pore-former, 1 wt %), polyvinyl butyral (binder, 2 wt %) in solvent 50 vol% of ethyl acetate and 50 vol% ethanol for 48 h using zirconia balls (6.5 mm).

nodes.name: Tape casting and hot pressing
nodes.procedure: Then, the Ni-Fe slurry was tape-casted onto a casting polypropylene film (CPP) using a doctor blade with a 700 μm opening. After that, the metal film was peeled off from CPP and cut into the required size for further hot-press lamination processing. The hot-pressing parameters were set at 80 °C under 0.5 MPa for 30 min.

nodes.name: Pyrolysis at 800°C
nodes.procedure: The high-temperature pyrolysis process was achieved through a tubular furnace in a 5% H2/N2 atmosphere. Metal films of the designed size are individually heated to 800 °C at a rate of 0.5 °C/min and maintained for 3 h at the maximum temperature.

nodes.description: S-AWE durability test at 1000 mA/cm² in 5 M KOH at 80°C
nodes.source_text: The constant current stability tests of NFA900-ac at 1000 mA cm⁻² in a 5 M KOH solution at 80°C... demonstrated an excellent industrial electrochemical stability for 500 h. The polarization curves without iR correction of NFA900-ac showed that the cell voltage is only 1.75 V at a current density of 500 mA cm⁻²

In the preliminary study conducted over a continuous 1100 h operation, we observed no significant increase in the voltage... Only a mass loss ratio of 7 %/1000 h indicates its extremely promising application prospects

nodes.characterization_summary: Synchrotron XRD shows complete alloying above 800°C with eight characteristic FCC peaks (20°-160° 2θ). FWHM decreases and crystallite size increases with synthesis temperature.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the synchrotron-based Xray diffraction (S-XRD) spectra presented in Fig. 1c, where the eight characteristic peaks that appear within the range of 20° to 160° correspond to the typical face-centered cubic (FCC) crystal phase... the full width at half maximum (FWHM) of all peaks decreases as the synthesis temperature increases

nodes.characterization_summary: Selected area electron diffraction of NFA900 along [110] matches FCC phase.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the relevant selected area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns images of NFA900 were shown... Fig. 1d... Along the zone axis of [110] directions, the electron diffraction spot pattern of NFA900 matches well with the FCC phase.

nodes.characterization_summary: Uniform distribution of Ni and Fe in bulk with Ni:Fe ratio close to 7.3:2.7.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The energy dispersive X-ray spectrometers (EDS) elemental mapping of NFA900 (Fig. 1f) indicates a uniform distribution of Ni and Fe in the bulk of alloy and the elemental ratio of Ni: Fe is close to 7.3: 2.7.

properties.description: Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy spectrum showing Ni and Fe peaks

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni-K and Fe-K edges show metallic valence state close to Ni-foil and Fe-foil.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy of Ni-K and Fe-K, show that as-prepared Ni7Fe3 alloy have a close energy with Ni-foil and Fe foil, indicating a metallic valence state of the bulk alloy.

nodes.characterization_summary: NFA800: total porosity 59.23%, effective porosity 47.63%, avg pore dia 3.47 μm; NFA900: total/effective porosity 41.89%, NFA1000: total/effective porosity 30.53%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The results reveal that the NFA800 exhibits the highest total porosity (59.23 %), but... NFA900 (41.89 %) and NFA1000 (30.53 %) is the same as their effective porosity. Meanwhile, the average pore diameter... from 3.47 μm (NFA-800) to 4.33 μm (NFA-1000).

nodes.characterization_summary: Tensile strengths: NFA800 31.11 MPa, NFA900 43.33 MPa, NFA1000 71.50 MPa.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The integrated NiFe alloy synthesized in this work demonstrates a superior tensile strength resistance (31.11 MPa for NFA-800, 43.33 MPa for NFA-900 and 71.50 MPa for NFA1000).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ex-situ Raman on cross-section after 1000 CV cycles shows NiOOH eg (479 cm⁻¹) and a1g (553 cm⁻¹) modes at all positions 1-4.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman spectrum showed that the two broad bands of NiOOH appeared at each location, corresponding to the eg mode at 479 cm⁻¹ and the a1g mode at 553 cm⁻¹, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p3/2 peaks at 852.8 eV (Ni⁰), 854.9 eV (Ni²⁺), 856.6 eV (Ni³⁺). Ni-O proportion increases and Fe-O binding energy rises with synthesis temperature.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution Ni 2p3/2 XPS spectra... presents four main peaks. The peaks located at 852.8 eV, 854.9 eV, 856.6 eV, and 861.84 eV are assigned to metal Ni, Ni²⁺, Ni³⁺, and satellite peaks, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Double layer capacitance (Cdl) decreases with synthesis temperature: NFA800-ac > NFA900-ac > NFA1000-ac, reflecting ECSA trend.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the electrochemical surface area (ECSA), expressed by the double layer capacitance (CDL) obtained from the CV curves of different sweep speeds... shows the decay of the alloy's active surface area with the synthesis temperature.
